sections.title: Financial Wisdom
sections.text: My son If they say let's swallow them up alive like Sheol We'll find all valuable wealth. We'll fill our houses with spoil. You shall cast your lot among us. We'll all have one purse. My son for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood. For in vain is the net spread in the sight of any bird: but these lay wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives. So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

sections.title: Financial Wisdom
sections.text: Listen for I give you sound learning. Don't forsake my law. For I was a son to my father He taught me Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don't forget Don't forsake her Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes Esteem her She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.
sections.summary: Thematic unit on General Financial Wisdom

sections.title: Financial Wisdom
sections.text: Listen I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths. When you go Take firm hold of instruction. Don't let her go. Keep her Don't enter into the path of the wicked. Don't walk in the way of evil men. Avoid it For they don't sleep For they eat the bread of wickedness But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don't know what they stumble over.
sections.summary: Thematic unit on General Financial Wisdom

sections.title: Financial Wisdom
sections.text: My son Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the midst of your heart. For they are life to those who find them Keep your heart with all diligence Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you. Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you. Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established. Don't turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
sections.summary: Thematic unit on General Financial Wisdom

sections.title: Financial Wisdom
sections.text: My son Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye. Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart. Tell wisdom that they may keep you from the strange woman For at the window of my house I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding passing through the street near her corner in the twilight Behold She is loud and defiant. Her feet don't stay in her house. Now she is in the streets So she caught him Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. This day I have paid my vows. Therefore I came out to meet you I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry I have perfumed my bed with myrrh Come For my husband isn't at home. He has gone on a long journey. He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon. With persuasive words He followed her immediately Until an arrow strikes through his liver Now therefore Don't let your heart turn to her ways. Don't go astray in her paths for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes Her house is the way to Sheol
